text: REJECT: `RunTurnAsync` itself is now trivial, but its body moved wholesale into the new `ExecuteTurnAsync`, which by my count still scores about 17 (above 15) from its many ternaries (one nested), the `||`/`&&` runs, and the `foreach` and `if` branches, so the same finding just reappears on a new method. I could not build the project here. The refactor looks behaviour-preserving, but it uses type names I couldn't check (`Dropped`, `OwedWrite`), which could break the build.
